title: Exact completion from the intrinsic-complete reflection and its unit criterion
statement: On a small pro-etale site and for an adic coefficient datum d, there exist an additive exact endofunctor F of the actual completed-coefficient derived category, a coherent integer-shift comparison, and a shift-compatible natural unit eta:Id -> F, such that a complex is intrinsically derived complete if and only if eta at that complex is invertible. This is only the completion part of the uniform-category argument; no constructibility or etale-origin conclusion is asserted.

source.place: ## Proof: implicit triangulation needed for the constructible restriction; agent supplement. Stacks Tag 09C3, proetale.tex, lemma-local-structure-constructible-complex, supplies contextual local models, not this tower-category closure theorem.

proof.text: Use the published intrinsic-complete inclusion and its left adjoint, whose unit is the actual completion unit. Closure under isomorphisms follows directly by transporting the existential cochain representative in PbcIsIntrinsicallyComplete. For a fully faithful right adjoint, the unit is invertible exactly on its essential image; isomorphism closure identifies this image with the original completeness predicate.

The unit-normalized completion shift makes the completeness predicate stable under every integer shift, since the shifted unit is a conjugate of the shift of the original unit. To prove triangulation, identify the reflective subcategory P with its double orthogonal. For X in the double orthogonal complete its unit to a distinguished triangle X -> F(X) -> Z -> X[1]. The universal Hom bijection shows Z is left orthogonal to P: use exactness of Hom and the shifted universal Hom bijection. Since X[1] is right orthogonal the connecting arrow is zero; exactness of Hom then factors id_Z through F(X), forcing id_Z=0. Thus the unit of X is invertible. Orthogonals are triangulated by the Mathlib instances.

The full inclusion of this triangulated predicate is exact. Give its left adjoint the adjunction-induced shift. Mathlib triangulated adjunction then makes that adjoint exact and additive, and makes its unit shift-compatible. Composing with the exact inclusion gives the required exact pointed endofunctor and the already proved unit criterion.

proof_origin.place: Completion part: reuse the existing shift-compatible reflection and prove its exactness through the double-orthogonal argument in Lean.
